releaseNotes: Desktop canvas now includes a snap-to-grid toggle for more precise prompt, image, workflow, and grouped-card positioning.
Manual canvas groups can now collapse into compact cards and expand back without rendering hidden members or connectors.
Hosted/VPS release guardrails, package metadata, workspace packages, and portable version manifests are aligned to version 1.4.6.
The 1.4.6 hosted release now uses the verified kkai.plus same-origin API with an HTTPS VPS upstream while the permanent api.kkai.plus DNS record awaits Cloudflare access.
